items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: We used to play with Nat Tolles.

ctx.x: He was playing piano. He was playing with, what's that boy's name, I used to be on the Al C. Page, you ever run across him? No. Out of Monroe, you met Ben Boyden? I heard of him. Yeah, he's dead now. And Nat Tolles, you remember him?
